mapper.select: SELECT a.* FROM sys_app a JOIN sys_user_app ua ON ua.app_id = a.id AND ua.is_deleted = 0 AND ua.status = 1 JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = ua.user_id AND u.is_deleted = 0 AND u.status = 1 WHERE ua.user_id = #{userId} AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND a.status = 1 AND a.code <> 'workspace' AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role ur JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.app_id = a.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND ur.is_deleted = 0 ) ORDER BY a.sort_no, a.id

SELECT r.* FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_app a ON a.id = r.app_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id AND ur.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND a.code = #{appCode} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 ORDER BY r.role_sort, r.id

SELECT r.* FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_app a ON a.id = r.app_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id AND ur.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND a.code = #{appCode} AND r.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY r.role_sort, r.id

SELECT r.role_code FROM sys_role r JOIN sys_app a ON a.id = r.app_id AND a.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id AND ur.is_deleted = 0 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND a.code = #{appCode} AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1

SELECT DISTINCT m.permission FROM sys_app a JOIN sys_role r ON r.app_id = a.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id AND ur.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = r.id AND rm.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sys_menu m ON m.app_code = a.code AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 AND m.id = rm.menu_id WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND a.code = #{appCode} AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND m.permission IS NOT NULL AND m.permission <> ''

SELECT DISTINCT m.* FROM sys_app a JOIN sys_role r ON r.app_id = a.id AND r.is_deleted = 0 AND r.status = 1 JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.role_id = r.id AND ur.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sys_role_menu rm ON rm.role_id = r.id AND rm.is_deleted = 0 JOIN sys_menu m ON m.id = rm.menu_id AND m.app_code = a.code AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 WHERE ur.user_id = #{userId} AND a.code = #{appCode} AND a.is_deleted = 0 AND m.menu_type IN ('DIR', 'MENU') AND m.hidden = 1 ORDER BY m.sort_no, m.id
SELECT m.* FROM sys_menu m WHERE m.app_code = #{appCode} AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 AND m.menu_type IN ('DIR', 'MENU') AND m.hidden = 1 ORDER BY m.sort_no, m.id
SELECT DISTINCT m.permission FROM sys_menu m WHERE m.app_code = #{appCode} AND m.is_deleted = 0 AND m.status = 1 AND m.permission IS NOT NULL AND m.permission <> ''
